title: Film Independent Fiction Producing Lab
summary: Intensive two-week program in October for creative independent producers, with lab sessions on legal, financial and production topics, a Creative Advisor for your project, professional coaching, and a closing pitch session with established executives.
dateText: Takes place over two weeks in October; application dates not stated
deadlineNote: No application deadline is stated on this page.
